## Checklist

- [ ] **England & Wales only** — no Scots / NI law introduced
- [ ] If a skill changed: `legal/SKILL.md` router **and** `registry/skill-registry.json` updated to match
- [ ] `npm run test:skills` passes (skill ↔ agent ↔ router ↔ registry parity)
- [ ] `npm run test:docs` passes (command reference regenerated + docs parity)
- [ ] Output still begins with the standard disclaimer block; risk indicators are 🔴/🟡/🟢
- [ ] Post-2024 reforms are written **commencement-aware** (not stated as binding unless commenced)
